objective: Add a deterministic test to test/mission-runtime.test.mjs proving that one valid actor action resets consecutiveRefusals. The injected dispatch sequence must be: round 1 refusal or invalid record; round 2 valid read action; round 3 refusal or invalid record; round 4 valid edit of calc.mjs that passes verification. With maxConsecutiveRefusals set to 2, assert exactly four dispatch waves, a verified candidate, and a terminal verified actor. A test that merely exercises multiple actors or consecutive refusals does not satisfy this objective.
constraints: Do not weaken or remove existing assertions.
The test itself must make no provider calls.
Assert the exact four-wave refusal/read/refusal/edit sequence and final verified status.
